Malay: Malaysian standard, standard form first, no spoken forms, chapter 6 affix gates (no ber-, meN-, -kan or -i; se- and ter- as chapter 6 allows), «daripada» in comparisons and for people and organisations, «dari» for places and times; «kita» for the speaker's own team (the listener included). Cari Benda ⚡ on the «Main badminton» picture scene. All Japanese is a draft for the native check.

L-1333.ja: チーム：«pasukan futsal»＝フットサルチーム。

L-1337.en: betul (Ch3), said twice: really, truly. «Betul-betul?» = Really?
L-1337.ja: betul（第3課）を2回：本当に。«Betul-betul?»＝本当に？

L-1363.en: se- + lama (Ch6): for (a length of time). «selama tiga jam» = for three hours.
L-1363.ja: se- + lama（第6課）：〜の間。«selama tiga jam»＝3時間。

L-1558.en: To play against, fight, oppose: «Kita lawan siapa?» = Who are we playing against?
L-1558.ja: 対戦する、戦う：«Kita lawan siapa?»＝どこと対戦するの？

L-1559.ja: 板、ボード：«papan skor»＝スコアボード、«papan klip»＝クリップボード。

L-1561.en: se- + baik (Ch1): as good as. «sebaik gurunya» = as good as his teacher.
L-1561.ja: se- + baik（第1課）：〜と同じくらい上手。«sebaik gurunya»＝先生と同じくらい上手。

L-1562.en: Difference: «beza skor» = the difference in the score.

L-1564.en: Futsal: five-a-side football, very popular in Malaysia.
L-1564.ja: フットサル：5人制サッカー。マレーシアでとても人気。

L-1565.en: Times, -fold: «dua kali ganda» = twice as much, double.

L-1566.en: ke-an + banyak (Ch5): most. «kebanyakan pelajar» = most students.
L-1566.ja: ke-an + banyak（第5課）：大部分の。«kebanyakan pelajar»＝ほとんどの学生。

L-1567.en: To run. «lumba lari» = a running race.
L-1567.ja: 走る。«lumba lari»＝かけっこ、競走。

L-1570.en: Mark, score (in a test or a game).

L-1571.en: Competition, match; taught as a whole word.
L-1571.ja: 試合、大会（ひとまとまりの単語として）。

L-1572.en: se- + banyak (Ch5): as many as, a total of (formal, in reports and notices).
L-1572.ja: se- + banyak（第5課）：〜もの、合計〜（報告やお知らせの改まった言い方）。

L-1573.en: Truly, really, after an adjective: «lemah sungguh» = really weak.
L-1573.ja: 本当に（形容詞の後）：«lemah sungguh»＝本当に弱い。

L-1574.ja: よくやった！おめでとう！

frames.example: Pasukan kita lebih lemah daripada pasukan mereka.
frames.meaning_en: Our team is weaker than theirs.
frames.meaning_ja: 私たちのチームは彼らのチームより弱い。

frames.frame: ___ saya dua kali ganda daripada ___ dia.
frames.example: Markah saya dua kali ganda daripada markah dia.
frames.meaning_ja: 私の点数は彼の2倍です。

frames.frame: Kebanyakan ___ suka futsal, tetapi saya suka ___.
frames.example: Kebanyakan pelajar suka futsal, tetapi saya suka catur.
frames.meaning_en: Most students like futsal, but I like chess.
frames.meaning_ja: ほとんどの学生はフットサルが好きですが、私はチェスが好きです。

frames.example: Semalam saya main catur selama tiga jam.
frames.meaning_en: Yesterday I played chess for three hours.
frames.meaning_ja: きのう3時間チェスをしました。

frames.example: Anak saya main catur sebaik gurunya.
frames.meaning_en: My child plays chess as well as his teacher.
frames.meaning_ja: 子どもは先生と同じくらいチェスが上手です。

frames.frame: Sebanyak ___ pelajar ada di pertandingan ___ ___ itu.
frames.example: Sebanyak seratus pelajar ada di pertandingan lumba lari itu.
frames.meaning_en: As many as a hundred students were at that running race.
frames.meaning_ja: その競走大会には100人もの学生がいました。

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Encik Tanaka, pasukan futsal kita ada pertandingan hujung minggu ini.
lines.en: Mr Tanaka, our futsal team has a match this weekend.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.en: Wow, fun! Who are we playing against?

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Pasukan syarikat Encik Lim. Mereka lebih cepat daripada kita.
lines.en: Mr Lim's company team. They're faster than us.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Betul-betul? Tetapi pasukan kita lebih bagus!
lines.en: Really? But our team is better!
choices: Betul-betul? Mereka lebih lambat daripada kita.
Betul-betul? Saya tidak pernah main catur.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Tahun lepas kita kalah, lima kosong.
lines.en: Last year we lost, five nil.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Lima kosong? Pasukan kita lemah sungguh!
lines.en: Five nil? Our team is really weak!
choices: Lima kosong? Syabas, Cik Mei Ling!
choices_en: Five nil? Our team is the champion!
Five nil? Well done, Ms Mei Ling!

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Ya, tetapi tahun ini kita ada latihan setiap minggu.
lines.en: Yes, but this year we practise every week.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Encik Tanaka pun boleh main. Encik lari lebih cepat daripada Encik Rahman!
lines.en: You can play too, Mr Tanaka. You run faster than Mr Rahman!

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.en: Well done! We won, three two!

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Terima kasih! Pasukan kita betul-betul bagus.
lines.en: Thank you! Our team is really good.
choices: Terima kasih! Kita kalah lima kosong.
Maaf, saya lambat. Pertandingan mula pukul berapa?
choices_en: Thank you! We lost five nil.
Sorry I'm late. What time does the match start?

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Beza skor satu sahaja, tetapi kita menang!
lines.en: Only one goal in it, but we won!

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Ya! Tahun depan pun kita menang.
lines.en: Yes! Next year we'll win too.
